image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a vintage, rusted agricultural plow resting in tall green grass. The image focuses on the lower section of the implement, showing a curved metal beam (standard) connecting to a horizontal share and moldboard assembly near the ground. A portion of a large, spoked iron wheel is visible in the bottom left foreground. The metal surfaces are heavily corroded with reddish-brown rust.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The grass blades immediately adjacent to the metal share show slight smudging and lack of crisp occlusion boundaries, suggesting minor blending issues between the object and the background texture.

The inner structure of the wheel spokes appears somewhat indistinct and 'mushy' rather than having sharp, rigid geometric lines typical of cast iron, indicating potential generative softness in complex mechanical details.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of agricultural implement and distinguish it from other farm tools like harrows or cultivators.
To verify the physical connectivity between the share and moldboard and check for edge bleeding into the grass.
To ensure the wheel sits correctly on the ground plane and the frame has consistent 3D perspective.

focus_areas: Connectivity of the share to the moldboard
Sharpness of the wheel spokes vs. background
Occlusion boundaries between metal and grass
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the rusted metal and the green grass.
